jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone. 

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

 

What you'll do

This is a full-cycle sales role for a driven seller who thrives on building pipelines, developing relationships, and closing new business. As an Account Executive, you'll own the sales process from outbound prospecting through negotiation and close, identifying and converting restaurant operators into CloudKitchens partners.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and qualification through discovery, negotiation, and closing.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline through cold calling, cold emailing, field prospecting, and multi-channel outreach

jobs.title: Associate Creative Producer
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches.

Testimonial Production

  • Coordinate with restaurant partners to produce video testimonials
  • Manage logistics: scheduling, locations, approvals, and communication

Social-First Content Creation

  • Create native, platform-first content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other social channels.
  • Be comfortable getting behind or in front of the camera when the concept calls for it.
  • Bring a strong understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, trends, and what makes people stop scrolling.
  • Regularly pitch and execute new content concepts that feel authentic to the platform—not like traditional corporate marketing.

Who we are 

At Picnic, we’re reinventing the way employees experience lunch at work. By partnering with top local restaurants and batching hundreds of orders, we make it easy for companies to offer high-quality, individually packed meals, without fees or tips. Our mission is to create a seamless, affordable, and joyful lunch experience that benefits both employees and employers.

 

About the role

As a Territory Restaurant Manager, you’ll own restaurant supply for the XYZ region: find the right restaurants, sign the partner, and make sure they deliver: enough capacity, prepped on time, packaged properly, with menus and photos worth ordering from. That means real ownership and real accountability from day one. You’ll spend time in facilities and restaurants, tasting food and talking to operators.

 

What you’ll do

  • Selection. Selection depth and cuisine coverage are a key KPI. You decide where it comes from: brick-and-mortar partners, standalone restaurants, and CK facility operators (with CK sales). You make sure every hub has real options at the different price tiers.
  • Restaurant performance. Signing, onboarding, launch, and ongoing health. You own the capacity model, drive on-time prep, and make the pause and unpause calls. If a partner’s prep-by times slip in month three, that’s yours to diagnose and fix.

jobs.description_text:
Location: In-Person (New York, NY)

Compensation: $17.00 – $20.00 / hour

Commitment: 20-30 hours/week

 

About Eulerity

At Eulerity, we are building the future of AI-driven marketing automation. Our platform helps franchises and multi-location businesses manage digital advertising at scale using machine learning, automation, and data.

Behind that technology is a Finance team building the financial infrastructure to support a growing company. We are looking for a highly organized, analytical, and detail-oriented Finance Intern to join our New York office and work directly with our Controller.

This is a hands-on role. You will work with real financial data, transactions, reconciliations, client media spend, reporting, and month-end close activities not just administrative tasks or theoretical exercises.

You will also gain exposure to how AI and automation can improve finance processes, reduce manual work, and analyze large datasets.

  • Accounting & Operations: Support AP/AR, reconciliations, and day-to-day accounting while maintaining accurate financial data.
  • Media Spend Tracking: Reconcile high-volume media spend and learn how gross vs. net revenue works in an AdTech business.

jobs.description_text:
CMM PROGRAMMER (2ND SHIFT)

Freeform is deploying software-defined, autonomous metal 3D printing factories around the world, bringing the scalability of software to physical production. Our proprietary technology stack leverages advanced sensing, real-time controls, and data-driven learning to produce digitally-verified, flawless parts at unprecedented speed and cost. Our mission is to make the transformative power of 3D printing available to all industries at scale and unlock the future of innovation.

We are looking for a detail-oriented CMM Inspector/Programmer to join our quality team and take ownership of inspecting complex metal 3D printed parts. In this hands-on role, you’ll operate our Zeiss Contura CMM using existing Calypso programs, perform part inspections, and clearly communicate results to the engineering and production teams. You’ll also assist in maintaining inspection tools, documenting results, and continuously improving quality workflows. Over time, you’ll have opportunities to learn more advanced metrology tools and inspection methods in our growing lab. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about precision inspection, quality assurance, and continuous improvement, we’d love to hear from you!

Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits. 

As Head of Turbomachinery Technology, you will build and lead a new engineering division at Freeform. You will set the technical direction for rotating machinery designed around what metal 3D printing makes possible: integrated geometries, fewer parts, and performance that casting and machining cannot reach. You will take new architectures from first-principles analysis through hardware test, working alongside the teams that build our printing technology.
